stories.title: New service chiefs take charge on 1 July
stories.body: Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit becomes Vice Chief of the Air Staff; Air Marshal Jasvir Singh Mann takes over as AOC-in-C, Southern Air Command; Air Marshal Tejinder Singh becomes Chief of Integrated Defence Staff (CISC); Lt Gen Rajesh Pushkar takes charge of the Army's Southern Command.

one_liners: New service chiefs take charge on 1 July — Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit becomes Vice Chief of the Air Staff
